name: manual_8c470e
claim: Treat ~/.gemini as a portable, non-workspace public default config directory per official Google Antigravity and Gemini CLI documentation; referencing it as a standard generic path anchor is not workstation-path leaking or doxxing.

decisions.notes: Under LINT-006 and path hygiene rules, workstation-specific absolute user paths ($HOME/...) are forbidden in tracked portable memory. However, ~/.gemini (and $HOME/.gemini) is the vendor-specified, public default configuration directory documented in official Google Antigravity specifications, analogous to ~/.config, ~/.claude, or ~/.ssh. Using ~/.gemini as a generic, non-workspace default does not expose private username segments, download trees, or local host identities.
